task: Create six head/body directional textures and a matching front-body item image in paths parallel to Vertin.
reference_priority: Local original defines outfit and expression. Web images only corroborate the same default outfit and bag/accessory construction; no alternate garment or smiling expression substitution.

expression.observed: Opaque sunglasses over the eyes; visible closed mouth with a small downward turn/slight pout; composed, cool, faintly stubborn rather than broadly cheerful.
avoid: invented visible pupils through dark lenses

head.hair: Sandy light-brown layered chin-to-nape bob, lightly flicked ends, short swept bangs.
head.hat: Off-white soft sailor/newsboy cap, black short visor, brick-red piping and side buttons, red-bordered dark heart badge on the front panel slightly toward character left.
head.glasses: Large black rounded rectangular opaque dark-brown/near-black sunglasses with a distinct bridge; subdued flat lens accent only.
head.facial_identity_marks: No obvious characteristic freckles, scars or burns in the local portrait; conditional facial-mark rule skipped.
head.head_body_partition: Scarf belongs to the body; head contains no shoulders, scarf or torso.

outfit.jacket: Rust-orange short open bomber with cream paired edge stripes, dark buttons on character right front; original complete sleeves/hands omitted per pawn convention, only short shoulder caps remain.
outfit.dress: Loose deep navy A-line short dress, simple drape, narrow pale lilac hem stripe. No forced cinched waist or pants conversion.
outfit.scarf: Blue-violet with large sparse cream polka dots, tied toward character left at the front neck; one front tail, one short lateral end.
outfit.legs: Compact exposed knees/lower thighs, rust-orange tall socks, near-black boots with cream folded cuffs/bands and small bows. Feet turn downward and gather inward.
outfit.bag: Original dark grey/navy record backpack carried from character left shoulder, lying behind left back/hip, with orange trim/handles, a few pale record sleeves, cream straps/buckles, orange peace-hand pin edged turquoise, a small silver star pendant and turquoise charm.

physical_side_map.front: Character left is viewer right: scarf knot/lateral end, visible shoulder strap/pin and partial bag. Front heart badge is slightly viewer right.
physical_side_map.east: True right-facing profile exposes character left side. Bag lies behind body toward screen left; near shoulder pin/strap and visible scarf detail remain. Do not put bag in front of chest.
physical_side_map.back: Character left is viewer left: bag/strap/charms. No repeated front buttons, front scarf tail, peace pin or heart badge on the back panels unless actually visible around the side.

dimension_rule.reason: The user local outfit is a loose cropped jacket over a loose A-line dress. Garment outline and drape take priority.
dimension_rule.scale_reference: Use the existing Vertin v13 and suitable Arknights pawn heads/bodies at the same native pixel scale to calibrate compact head/face size, neck join and overall height; do not impose Vertin's fitted waist/hip curve.
dimension_rule.body_type_note: Asset naming/render-target choice consistent with the existing project's single pawn body family; not a requirement to draw a tight narrow waist.

format.side_body_pose: Continuous mildly forward diagonal with coherent thickness; knees/boots continue down the line. Garment and bag follow their own cloth/construction contours without an abrupt > shaped waist.

reconstructed_areas: Exact orthographic profile/rear hair and cap shape inferred from the local front portrait.
Rear jacket seam, dress folds and scarf wrap inferred conservatively; no front ornaments copied to the back.
Bag's panels and contents corroborated by original single-item web images; placement and visible side/back occlusion reconstructed from its character-left carry position.
